claims.text: Equimolar CoCrFeNiTi in a simple solid-solution state has relatively low hardness and strength.
Equimolar CoCrFeNiTi in that state has high ductility and favorable machinability.
The mechanical-property balance of CoCrFeNiTi is governed by the absence of significant short-range atomic order.
Chemical ordering in other HEAs or modified compositions creates strong obstacles to dislocation motion.
The random chemical environment in unmodified CoCrFeNiTi produces only moderate lattice distortion.
Dislocation glide in unmodified CoCrFeNiTi is relatively unhindered.
Relatively unhindered dislocation glide promotes ductility and machinability while lowering hardness and strength.
The starting material is equimolar CoCrFeNiTi in an as-cast or conventionally processed simple solid-solution state.
A targeted thermal treatment can induce short-range order or incipient B2-like order in CoCrFeNiTi.
Adding an unspecified minor alloying element can induce short-range order or incipient B2-like order in CoCrFeNiTi.
Induced short-range order produces nanoscale chemically ordered regions.
Ordered regions interact with moving dislocations.
Nanoscale short-range-ordered regions act as dislocation-pinning sites.
Pinning by ordered clusters increases local slip resistance, yield strength, and hardness.
Relative to baseline CoCrFeNiTi, an SRO-promoting modification should increase hardness and yield strength.
Relative to baseline CoCrFeNiTi, an SRO-promoting modification should reduce plastic strain.
The proposed effect applies below the temperature at which the induced order disorders and should be most pronounced near room temperature.
Grain-size variation, precipitation, defect-density differences, and competing deformation mechanisms could confound the attributed SRO effect.

contradictions.description: The experiment calls both specimen sets equimolar CoCrFeNiTi while also permitting an alloying modification of the second set; adding another element would generally make that set no longer equimolar CoCrFeNiTi unless a fully specified compositional rebalance were provided.
